notes: Competing reading at t010: the *of* of *one of thy brethren* could be read as the construct relation belonging to the rectum אַחֶיךָ under rule 19, leaving the partitive מִן unrepresented under rule 40. It is placed on מִן because the ASV writes only one preposition for the phrase and rule 11 gives a present function morpheme the English it licenses; the parallel בְּאַחַד שְׁעָרֶיךָ in the same verse shows the *of* falling to the rectum only where the preposition already holds a word of its own (*within*).
אֶבְיוֹן → *a poor man* is headed on *poor* by rule 31's subtraction, *man* being the supplied generic; the ASV writes no bare *man* for a word of that class here.
The article of הָאֶבְיוֹן is unrepresented because the suffix already licenses the phrase's one determiner *thy*, under rule 41's limit.
